title: AM243 SOES stationary protocol checks
prerequisites: Follow root hardware authorization and the model operating guide.
Freeze firmware, source, setup and configuration before a new test.
procedure: Reproduce the steps in the retained historical evidence.
Record actual observations, failures, exact timestamps and operator identity for a new run.
workload: Two cold boots, session identity checks and software-channel CoE/PDO operations.
measurement_point: As recorded in the source; host/protocol observations are not physical output measurements.
clock_domains: Use the clocks stated in the historical evidence; unknown domains remain unknown.

checks.metric: Discovery, OP, retry, watchdog and recovery checks completed
checks.measurement_method: Production paired adapter/probe and retained console narrative.

required_evidence: Observed measurements or protocol results with retained logs
Execution and review identities/times, or explicit historical gaps
limitations: Historical reconstruction describes the recorded check; it does not claim a new predeclared procedure or broader qualification.
